request.description: Fresh simple pixel-art BASE DESIGN for DUSKMANTLE, a mysterious adult caretaker of a moonlit garden. Use the original drawing only for identity: long bangs, an oversized scarf wrapped around the lower face/neck and a flowing cloak. Face mostly concealed, reserved unreadable expression; no monster face or elaborate armor. A lean adult silhouette, normal-sized head, cloak hanging in a few broad readable folds, scarf ends clear but not tangled. Quiet standing pose facing slightly left, feet planted. Keep the costume SIMPLE: muted deep-violet cloak, subdued scarf, dark boots; restrained colors and only two or three flat shades per material. Match approved game art: bold dark outlines, coherent broad pixel clusters, clean shapes. No tiny decorative details, intricate trim, noisy shading, white/light-gray speckles, dithering or gradients. Not chibi or baby-like. No weapons, staff, skulls, extra props, magic effects, scenery or text. Full body, scarf and cloak entirely inside transparent 192x192 square with generous margins for future expressive animation.
